item.title: Good ideas do not need lots of lies in order to gain public acceptance (2008)
item.description:
📝 Krugman's post about the Paulson bailout plan; I don't actually have a fully formed view about that plan. Why is it that you were right about everything at precisely the same moment when we were wrong. Since the tech companies' point of view appeared to be that if they were ever forced to account honestly for their option grants, they would quickly stop making them, this offered decent prima facie evidence that they weren't, really, all that fantastic.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.danieldavies.com/2004/05/d-squared-digest-one-minute-mba.html

item.title: Yggdrasil Network
item.description:
📝 Yggdrasil is a new experimental compact routing scheme. It provides end-to-end encrypted IPv6 routing between all network participants. Even though the Yggdrasil Network provides IPv6 routing between nodes, peering connections can be set up over either IPv4 or IPv6 networks.
🔗 Read more: https://yggdrasil-network.github.io/
